notes: Hydrex (confirmed), Catalyst Markets (observed) and the Doppler protocol with Bankr as a known integrator. Add launchpads in the same shape as registry/4663.json.

launchpads.name: Hydrex (Hydropump)
launchpads.stack: Permissionless launcher (UUPS proxy). Fixed 10B-supply immutable ERC-20, Algebra Integral pool vs a whitelisted quote (PairDirectory), 5 single-sided bands, positions locked forever; 75/25 creator/protocol fee split; 10-block anti-snipe buy tax.

emitters.label: HydropumpLauncher
emitters.source: github.com/hydrexfi/hydropump-contracts (public source, 'Permissionless token launch contracts for Hydrex on Base'); proxy created 2026-09-25T18:31:53Z by 0x40fbfe5312330f278824ddbb7521ab77409192f0, block 51785883

launchpads.name: Catalyst Markets
launchpads.stack: Permissioned (EIP-712 signature from a registry signer). 1,000,000-supply Solady-style ERC-20 with Permit2, CREATE2 vanity prefix 0xca7a, Uniswap v4 pool vs USDC with a custom hook, 8-position seeding, per-market epoch vault.

events.signature: (unnamed: token, hook indexed; quote, 0, vault in data)

emitters.label: factory
emitters.source: Not published by Catalyst; contracts unverified. On-chain 2026-09-23: EIP-712 domain 'CatalystMarkets' v1 embedded in the factory bytecode; all 6 tokens it created carry the 0xca7a vanity prefix; catalyst.markets links these tokens.

launchpads.name: Doppler protocol
launchpads.stack: Permissionless launch protocol (Whetstone Research). Any app can launch through the Airlock; the integrator stored per asset names the app.

0xf60633d02690e2a15a54ab919925f3d038df16.source: Same integrator address as on Robinhood Chain (docs.bankr.bot: Doppler launches on Base, Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum). On-chain 2026-10-27: 65 Bankr-integrator launches in 11 h on Base.

wallets.source: On-chain 2026-10-27: Bankr's own hot wallets (plain EOAs, nonces 300k-540k, used for nothing but Bankr launches). The 12 newest Bankr-integrator launches, and later 25 of 25 sampled from 84 in 11 hours, were sent by these four, each with one VestingAllocated of 15% (30-day cliff, 1 year) from a 44-byte DopplerERC20V1 clone. Add a wallet when a launch listed on bankr.bot comes from a new one.

allocations.source: docs.bankr.bot (token-launching/overview, faq/token-launching) and the launch form, checked 2026-10-27: 'Creator vesting: 15% ... vests over 1 year with a 30-day cliff' or 'No vesting' (100% into the pool); 'A Doppler launch has no custom percentage or schedule.' Partner/org launches sell 100% with no vest.

launchpads.name: Bankr
launchpads.stack: Launches through the Doppler protocol (Airlock) from four hot wallets. Identified on-chain by its integrator address; not published by Bankr.

launchpads.name: o1 Launchpad
launchpads.stack: Uniswap v4 pool from launch, permanently locked, 1B supply. On Base the Standard launches are native B20 tokens (created through the B20 precompile 0xB20f…0000, so the B20 'creator' of every o1 token is that precompile, not o1). Factories before 2026-08-30 (v1–v4) could mint allocations at birth, unvested or through a vesting vault; the current factories cannot.
